title: calomeria gracillima
intro: Calomeria gracillima, commonly known as the False Rosemary or Calomeria, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Calomeria gracillima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and diterpenes, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential uses of this plant.
